title: Lenovo says to unveil 'Hybrid AI' strategy at CES 2027
summary: Lenovo said it will showcase connected personal AI experiences across PCs, smartphones, and wearables, alongside enterprise solutions aimed at building Hybrid AI factories and AI-native operations.
